name: Rename the user-facing 'Computer sessions' concept and centralise the labels
description:
'Computer sessions' is a technical, long name. Decide and apply ONE consistent user-facing name, and make it a single edit in the future.

Recommendation to implement (unless the codebase shows a stronger existing convention): section/nav = **Machines**, one item = **Machine session**, running/handoff state = **Live session**, 'New session' → 'New machine'. 'Co-working' is rejected because it collides with coworking spaces; 'Live sessions' alone is ambiguous (streams/meetings).

Work:
1. Create one label module in the UI (e.g. client/src/config/sessionLabels.js) exporting the strings (NAV, SINGLE, NEW, EMPTY, EMPTY_RAIL, RETRY, DELETE_TITLE, DELETE_HINT, LIBRARY...) and use it from every component instead of literals.
2. Replace user-facing occurrences found with project_locate (project='codx-junior-ui') for 'Computer session' / 'computer sessions': BrowserSessionList.vue (h2 'Computer sessions', 'No computer sessions yet', aria-labels 'New computer session', 'Retry loading computer sessions', delete confirm), BrowserSessionPanel.vue ('Select a computer session'), ComputerGridPicker.vue ('No computer sessions yet'), BrowserSessionCreateModal.vue header, ComputerImageLibrary.vue if it says computer sessions, plus the app/nav entry (find it with project_locate('Computer', include='src/config/*')) and any mobile/dock entry.
3. Keep code identifiers, API routes and the `computers.js` module name unchanged — this is a UI/docs rename only.
4. Update docs/features/computer-use.md (title, section headings and first paragraphs) and the computer-use tool descriptions in api/codx/junior/tools/__init__.py ONLY where they are user-facing prose.
5. Report the list of files touched and any string you deliberately left unchanged (API field names, logs, code comments).

Constraints: no unrelated reformatting; keep the diff mechanical and reviewable; check the client build after the change.

**Acceptance criteria**
A user-facing string search finds no remaining 'Computer sessions' outside intended places (code identifiers/API/docs history), all labels come from the central module, and the client build passes.
